sloka: न हि तावत् भवेत् कालो व्यतीतः चोदनात् ऋते ।चोदितस्य हि कार्यस्य भवेत् काल व्यतिक्रमः ॥४-२९-१९॥
transliteration: na hi tāvat bhavet kālo vyatītaḥ codanāt ṛte ।coditasya hi kāryasya bhavet kāla vyatikramaḥ ॥4-29-19॥

translations.english: 'O king pray accomplish his object the same way he has accomplished your own. You ought to issue orders to the foremost of the monkeys.
